# PRD — story-loom

*Generated by planner (story 9.5). Scope anchor only — keeps stories inside the MVP. Lean by design.*

---

## 1. Problem

Writers lose fleeting fiction ideas to scattered notes apps or forget them entirely. There is no lightweight tool to capture free-text creative notes (characters, scenes, scenarios) throughout the week and automatically synthesize them into a short story — providing a satisfying creative ritual and a shareable artifact.

## 2. Functional Requirements

| ID | Requirement |
|---|---|
| FR-1 | A user can type a free-text journal entry at any time; it is saved with a server-assigned timestamp. |
| FR-2 | This week's entries are displayed on the home page in reverse-chronological order. |
| FR-3 | A user can trigger weekly story generation (on-demand, not just Friday); the LLM weaves that week's entries into a short creative story. |
| FR-4 | Generated stories are stored and displayed alongside their week's entries; generating a second time for the same week overwrites (idempotent). |
| FR-5 | A history view lists all past weeks that have at least one entry. |
| FR-6 | Clicking a past week shows that week's entries and its generated story (if one exists), with the option to generate/regenerate. |

## 3. Non-Functional Requirements

| ID | Requirement |
|---|---|
| NFR-1 | Stack: Next.js 16 App Router + TypeScript + Tailwind + shadcn/ui + Prisma/Neon + Vercel AI SDK + Anthropic Claude + Vitest + GitHub Actions CI + Vercel deploy. |
| NFR-2 | Single-user, no authentication. |
| NFR-3 | Story generation call must include a loading/pending state in the UI; target < 30 s LLM response. |
| NFR-4 | All Server Actions validate input with Zod before any DB write or AI call. |
| NFR-5 | Vitest + RTL unit tests for all components; AI calls are mocked in tests. |

## 4. MVP Scope (in)

- Free-text entry creation with auto-timestamp (FR-1)
- This week's entry list on home page (FR-2)
- On-demand weekly story generation via LLM (FR-3)
- Story persistence and display (FR-4)
- History view: list of past weeks (FR-5)
- Per-week detail: entries + story + generate/regenerate (FR-6)

## 5. Out of Scope

- Auth / multi-user / login
- Entry tagging or categorization
- Editing or deleting generated stories
- Mobile-native app
- Email or push reminders / scheduled Friday trigger
- Calorie tracking, photo attachments, or any non-fiction-journal features
